headerDisplay: Controls a Samsung room air conditioner over its local network API. Add each unit's IP address below, then pair it from the card above — pairing needs the unit powered off and back on, so it cannot be done from this form alone.

name.title: Name
name.description: Shown in the Home app. Leave empty to use the name the unit reports.

host.title: IP address
host.description: Current or last-known address. Without a device UUID below, reserve this address in your router. With a UUID, it is a fallback and discovery hint.

deviceUuid.title: Device UUID for automatic discovery (optional)
deviceUuid.description: Use the UUID returned by this unit's local API or pairing record to follow address changes over SSDP. Leave empty to use only the configured IP address.

token.title: Device token (optional)
token.description: Only needed if you paired outside this plugin. Leave empty and use Pair above; tokens paired there are stored outside config.json.

heating.title: Heating
heating.description: Samsung units under-report what they support: the reference unit leaves Heat out of its mode list even while it is heating. Detection reads the unit's rated heating capacity instead, which is right for every unit seen so far. Set this only if the Home app offers a Heat button that does nothing, or hides one that should work.

updateInterval.title: Status poll interval (seconds)
updateInterval.description: How often to read the unit. This is a local network request, so it can be frequent.

swingDirection.title: Swing direction
swingDirection.description: Direction used by the main AC swing toggle. TP6X_RAC_17K units were verified with Fix, Up_And_Low, Left_And_Right and All. Some other models only support Up_And_Low.

convenienceModes.title: Convenience mode switches
convenienceModes.description: Adds switches for selected presets. Only one runs at a time. TP6X_RAC_17K units were verified with Nano (Wind free), 2Step, Speed (Fast Turbo), Comfort and Quiet. Other models may use different values. Use the separate Good Sleep duration setting for native timed sleep control.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: The unit's own word for it. This is what gets sent, and what the switch's HomeKit identity is built from — so a switch keeps its automations however it is named below.

name.title: Name in the Home app
name.description: Optional. Used exactly as written, without the AC name in front. Leave empty for the AC name followed by the Samsung preset name.

modeSwitches.title: Dry and fan-only switches
modeSwitches.description: Adds a switch for a mode HomeKit's air conditioner tile cannot express. Dry and fan-only (the unit calls it Wind) have no equivalent there, so without a switch they can only be set from the Samsung app — the plugin reports them as Auto and leaves them alone. Switching one off puts the unit back in the mode it was in before.

oneOf.title: Fan only (the unit calls it Wind)

name.title: Name in the Home app
name.description: Optional. Used exactly as you write it, with no air conditioner name in front of it. Leave it empty for '<air conditioner> <mode>'.

outdoorTemperature.title: Outdoor temperature sensor

oneOf.title: On — as a second sensor on the air conditioner (same room)
On — as a separate accessory (can be put in another room)
One shared sensor for a multisplit outdoor unit

outdoorTemperature.description: Publishes the unit's outdoor sensor as a temperature tile. On the air conditioner it takes that unit's room; as a separate accessory it appears on its own in the Home app, so you can assign it wherever you like — an outdoor room, say. It only shows up once the unit actually reports a reading. Shared publishes exactly one separate accessory using readings from all configured ACs. Use only when these ACs share one outdoor unit. A fresh reading from a running AC is preferred, with fallback to another unit.

outdoorTemperatureUnit.title: Outdoor temperature scale
outdoorTemperatureUnit.description: The scale the unit reports its outdoor sensor in. Stated nowhere in what the unit reports, and independent of the unit's own setting: a TP6X_RAC_16K reports itself in Celsius and this in Fahrenheit, measured against a known outdoor temperature. Fahrenheit is the default for that reason. If your tile reads far too cold, your unit reports Celsius here — switch it.

hideOutdoorTemperatureWhenOff.title: Hide the outdoor reading while the unit is off
hideOutdoorTemperatureWhenOff.description: Some units keep publishing an outdoor figure with the compressor stopped, and it is not one the sensor measured — it drifts towards the room's temperature instead. Turn this on if yours does: the tile then reads "No Response" while the unit is off rather than showing a number nothing measured, and goes live again the moment it starts. Leave it off if your outdoor reading is trustworthy when idle. With a shared sensor, hides the reading only when no running indoor unit has a fresh reading.

freezeIndoorTemperatureWhenOff.title: Hold the room temperature while the unit is off
freezeIndoorTemperatureWhenOff.description: Some units report an unreliable room temperature with the fan stopped. Turn this on if yours does: the air conditioner tile then keeps showing the last temperature read while it was running, until it starts again. Unlike the outdoor sensor this one cannot read "No Response" — HomeKit requires a room temperature on the air conditioner, and an error there would grey out the whole tile and leave you no way to switch the unit back on — so it holds the last good reading instead.

certificateUrl.title: Client certificate URL
certificateUrl.description: Advanced. Where to download the Samsung client certificate from. Change this only if you mirror it yourself.

autoCleanSwitch.title: Auto-clean switch
autoCleanSwitch.description: Show the self-drying setting when the AC reports Autoclean. On means enabled after shutdown, not cleaning now. Some units accept setting changes only while powered on.

shutdownTimers.title: Shutoff timer switches (minutes)
shutdownTimers.description: Optional local countdowns, for example 30, 60, 120. Start while the AC is on. Selecting another replaces the countdown; turning its switch off cancels it. Requires Homebridge to be running. Brief restarts preserve the deadline; timers more than five minutes overdue are discarded.

detailedSwing.title: Separate swing axes
detailedSwing.description: Adds Vertical swing and Horizontal swing switches. Both on selects All; both off selects Fix. Enable only after confirming all four directions on your model. Changes do not power on the AC.

spiSwitch.title: Purify switch
spiSwitch.description: Adds the Samsung Purify control using SPI (S-Plasma Ion) on/off when reported by the AC. Enable only after checking command support. The switch reflects the setting, not measured air quality or confirmation that ionizer hardware is installed.

adaptivePolling.title: Adaptive status polling
adaptivePolling.description: After a control change or HomeKit command, poll every 2 seconds for 30 seconds. Otherwise use the normal interval, even while off. Failed reads back off progressively to at least 60 seconds; successful reads restore normal polling. Polls never overlap and share the command read-back.

goodSleepMinutes.title: Good Sleep duration
goodSleepMinutes.description: Adds one native Good Sleep switch on verified TP6X_RAC_17K units. Start while running in Cool mode. Switching it off cancels Good Sleep and keeps the AC running. The duration is handled by the AC; it differs from the local shutoff timers.
